scope: Public source classes relevant to HPVS, HZT-M0, HZT-Full and UniverseLab software. Private conversation and account metadata are intentionally excluded.
epistemic_limit: The register covers source material that has been scientifically reviewed and sanitized for public provenance. Inaccessible or private archival material is not reconstructed here.

source_classes.role: Historical context and migration support only

source_classes.verification_note: Public provenance distinguishes project-declared canon from byte-verified uploaded versions.

canonical_decisions.statement: The governing architecture is HPVS -> HZT-M0-S6/HZT-M0-P5 -> HZT-Full.
UniverseLab is the operational integration layer, not the physical theory itself.
Technical execution is not physical identification; numerical stability is not ghost freedom; good fit is not theory confirmation.
K1-D remains NOT RELEASED and K1-E remains NOT ADMISSIBLE.
Global historical A0 benchmarks do not determine one-sided boundary derivatives or the two-junction verdict.
Observational likelihoods become theory tests only after a released model-dependent forward map.
Cellular automata are mathematical and heuristic demonstrators and are not identified with real cosmological structure formation.

private_archive_policy: Detailed conversation titles, account-audit filenames, conversation identifiers, attachment identifiers and private archive inventories are maintained outside the public repository.
unresolved_inventory_tasks: Hash-deduplicate private historical artifacts outside the public repository.
Map any scientifically relevant archival claim to a sanitized canonical document or an explicit OPEN migration task.
Mark superseded public UI and architecture proposals explicitly.
